visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the Nested Ifs with a Helper
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Deeply nested comparisons find the maximum. Write a small max function and use it twice instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The maximum of three numbers is the maximum of (the maximum of two) and the third. A two-argument helper removes four branches and is reusable for any number of values.
